questions.q: Job advert: 'You will often work alone, so we need someone with ______.'
A colleague is nervous about a presentation. Which advice is correct?
answers: You should to speak more slowly.
Why don't you to use bigger slides?
How about practising in front of a friend?

questions.q: You're emailing the CEO for the first time. Which sentence is TOO informal?
answers: I am delighted to join the Finance team.
Thanks a lot – catch you later!
I would be glad to discuss the budget with you.
Please let me know if I can help in any way.

questions.q: A fishing company catches tuna at sea. Which economic sector is this?
Thailand is building more wind farms and hydropower dams. It is investing in…
My phone ______ while we ______ the visitors around our new building.
Customer: 'This charger is broken.' Shop assistant: 'Sorry! I ______ you a new one.'
The decision was made yesterday: we ______ our prices next month.
Our profits rose by 40% this year – the strongest ______ in our history.

answers: Our coffee is grown in Chiang Rai.
The contract was sign last week.
These bottles is recycled every week.

questions.q: Which sentence belongs in the ENCLOSURES part of an order confirmation letter?
answers: Thank you for your order of 50 laptops.
We enclose a copy of our terms and conditions.
The laptops will arrive on Friday.
We discussed about the new prices.
We are thinking about open a new shop.
We are waiting for your reply.
